strong_uplift_rule: clear improvement across both intended-local classes, materially higher total usable coverage, manual scores predominantly 2-3 rather than 0-1, and substantial reduction in malformed/repetitive/wrong-code behavior
weak_uplift_rule: measurable improvement but not broad/reliable enough across intended-local classes or manual rubric
no_material_uplift_rule: small/inconsistent improvement or resource cost overwhelms useful quality gain
a2_1_verdict_order: quality gate is decided before performance gate
